description: This Scala source file defines the PushBasedFetchHelper class, which manages push-based shuffle block fetching, including handling push-merged blocks, fetching metadata, managing local and remote push-merged blocks, and fallback mechanisms in Apache Spark's shuffle process.

classes.name: PushBasedFetchHelper
classes.description: Helper class managing push-based shuffle block fetching, metadata, local/remote push-merged blocks, and fallback logic.

methods.name: isPushMergedShuffleBlockAddress
methods.description: Checks if a BlockManagerId corresponds to a push-merged shuffle block.

methods.name: isRemotePushMergedBlockAddress
methods.description: Checks if a BlockManagerId is a remote push-merged block.

methods.name: isLocalPushMergedBlockAddress
methods.description: Checks if a BlockManagerId is a local push-merged block.

methods.name: removeChunk
methods.description: Removes a shuffle chunk's metadata from the internal map.

methods.name: addChunk
methods.description: Adds or updates a shuffle chunk's bitmap metadata.

methods.name: getRoaringBitMap
methods.description: Retrieves the bitmap for a specific shuffle chunk.

methods.name: getShuffleChunkCardinality
methods.description: Returns the number of map blocks in a shuffle chunk.

methods.name: createChunkBlockInfosFromMetaResponse
methods.description: Creates fetch info for shuffle chunks based on metadata response.

methods.name: sendFetchMergedStatusRequest
methods.description: Sends request to fetch push-merged block metadata and handles responses.

methods.name: fetchAllPushMergedLocalBlocks
methods.description: Fetches all outstanding push-merged local blocks.

methods.name: fetchPushMergedLocalBlocks
methods.description: Fetches push-merged local blocks from cache or external shuffle service.

methods.name: fetchPushMergedLocalBlock
methods.description: Fetches a single push-merged local block's metadata.

methods.name: initiateFallbackFetchForPushMergedBlock
methods.description: Initiates fallback to fetch original blocks when push-merged fetch fails.
